_comment: Tier-2 for fenics navier_stokes#9: XDMFFile.write_function only accepts a Function whose degree matches the mesh geometry degree, so a P2 velocity cannot be written directly. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 interpolates into a matching P1 vector space first, which is one of the two documented cures. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
